# Contract: Acceptance Test Template

## Overview

Defines the structure of the `acceptance-test-template` preset template that controls the output format of generated Playwright test files. Users can override this template via `.specify/templates/overrides/acceptance-test-template.md`.

## File Location

```
bundle/presets/trasgospec/templates/acceptance-test-template.md
```

## Template Structure

The template defines the skeleton of a generated `.spec.ts` file with placeholders:

```typescript
/**
 * @generated by speckit.trasgospec.acceptance-tests
 * @spec {SPEC_PATH}
 * @story {STORY_ID} - {STORY_TITLE}
 * @generated-at {TIMESTAMP}
 *
 * DO NOT DELETE this header block. It identifies this file as agent-generated
 * and enables incremental updates when the spec changes.
 */

import { test, expect } from '{FIXTURES_IMPORT}';

test.describe('{STORY_ID} - {STORY_TITLE}', () => {
  // For each scenario in the user story:

  /**
   * Scenario {SCENARIO_NUMBER}:
   * Given {GIVEN_TEXT}
   * When {WHEN_TEXT}
   * Then {THEN_TEXT}
   */
  test('{STORY_ID}-S{SCENARIO_NUMBER}: {SCENARIO_DESCRIPTION}', async ({ {FIXTURES} }) => {
    await test.step('Given {GIVEN_TEXT}', async () => {
      // Arrange: {GIVEN_IMPLEMENTATION}
    });

    await test.step('When {WHEN_TEXT}', async () => {
      // Act: {WHEN_IMPLEMENTATION}
    });

    await test.step('Then {THEN_TEXT}', async () => {
      // Assert: {THEN_IMPLEMENTATION}
    });
  });
});
```

## Placeholder Definitions

| Placeholder | Source | Description |
|-------------|--------|-------------|
| `{SPEC_PATH}` | `.specify/feature.json` → spec.md | Repo-relative path to spec file |
| `{STORY_ID}` | Parsed heading | `US{N}` format (e.g., `US1`) |
| `{STORY_TITLE}` | Parsed heading text | e.g., "Core Test Generation" |
| `{TIMESTAMP}` | Generation time | ISO 8601 format |
| `{FIXTURES_IMPORT}` | Project context | Path to fixtures file (e.g., `./fixtures`) |
| `{FIXTURES}` | Page objects used | Destructured fixture names (e.g., `loginPage, checkoutPage`) |
| `{SCENARIO_NUMBER}` | Parsed list position | 1-based index within story |
| `{SCENARIO_DESCRIPTION}` | Derived from GWT | Short description of the scenario |
| `{GIVEN_TEXT}` | Parsed from spec | Full Given clause text |
| `{WHEN_TEXT}` | Parsed from spec | Full When clause text |
| `{THEN_TEXT}` | Parsed from spec | Full Then clause text |
| `{GIVEN_IMPLEMENTATION}` | AI-generated | Arrange code (page navigation, data setup) |
| `{WHEN_IMPLEMENTATION}` | AI-generated | Act code (user interactions) |
| `{THEN_IMPLEMENTATION}` | AI-generated | Assert code (expect assertions) |

## Template Resolution Order

1. `.specify/templates/overrides/acceptance-test-template.md` (user override)
2. `.specify/presets/trasgospec/templates/acceptance-test-template.md` (installed preset)
3. Hardcoded default in the command file (fallback)

## Consumers

- `speckit.trasgospec.acceptance-tests` command (resolves and fills the template)
- Users (override via `.specify/templates/overrides/`)

## Validation Rules

- Template MUST contain the `@generated by speckit.trasgospec.acceptance-tests` sentinel
- Template MUST use `test.step()` for GWT sections
- Template MUST include all placeholder fields listed above
- Template MUST use `test.describe` for story grouping and `test()` for individual scenarios
